title: Phoenicians crossed the Atlantic and mined copper in the Great Lakes

tellings.quote: I think they crossed the Atlantic I think they were mining copper >> in the great lakes

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, on the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, says he believes the Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people of the eastern Mediterranean, crossed the Atlantic Ocean. He thinks they mined copper around the Great Lakes of North America, which would mean people from the Old World reached America in ancient times.
